all_pod_rows.authorization_scope_limitation: This billing window includes Pods created under distinct earlier authorization tranches. Do not compare the all-Pod total directly with the later EXP701 $9/10-hour controller tranche; use the attempt-scoped controller ledger for admission.

late_posting_correction.explanation: The provider API posted the final 2026-08-06 22:00 hourly Pod and network-volume buckets after the first observation. The corrected totals above supersede the partial observation.

assumptions: The account contained exactly $10 before this billing window.
No unrelated Pod, Serverless, storage, tax, credit adjustment, or charge exists outside the queried billing records.
The final 22:00 hourly Pod and network-volume buckets had posted by the corrected observation.
credit_estimate.exact_balance_source: RunPod Billing console or `runpodctl user`; the current REST OpenAPI exposes usage history but not clientBalance.

post_terminal_waste_estimate.basis: Attempt-L Pod billing time minus elapsed time from Pod creation to the latest rescued archive's internal guest-supervisor modification time, used as the final terminal-export proxy.
post_terminal_waste_estimate.classification: calculated estimate from provider billing, not a separately itemized RunPod charge

limitations: The network-volume billing endpoint did not attribute every amount to an attempt in this receipt.
The current account balance was not returned by the REST API, so estimated remaining credit is not an exact ledger balance.
Post-terminal waste is an attribution calculation; RunPod reported total time and amount, not a terminal-versus-post-terminal split.
The terminal-export proxy is the 20:23:14 UTC internal mtime in the newest rescued archive; the earlier host sync stopped at 20:10 and did not capture that terminal generation.
